Subject: Sable model intermittent 5xx/timeouts — initial notice

Hi Ava / Stratos team,

Quick heads up: we observed an elevated rate of 5xx responses and timeouts for requests routed to the "sable" model starting ~20:40 PDT tonight. The error rate peaked around 21:05 and we rolled an automated fallback to the compatible "sable-lite" variant for affected requests. You may have seen a small number of failed calls or increased latency between 20:40–21:10.

What we know so far:
- Symptom: intermittent 5xx errors (503/504) and timeouts affecting generation and streaming calls for sable.
- Scope: approximately 7% of requests for your workload were affected during the spike; we throttled and routed ~90% of new requests to sable-lite automatically.
- Immediate mitigation: routing/fallback to sable-lite and temporary circuit-breaker adjustments.

We're attaching initial logs and a short timeline snapshot. Our on-call infra team (cc'd) is triaging; I wanted to notify you asap and will follow up with a recovery/update once we have root cause or longer-term mitigation.

Next steps / ask:
- Can you confirm if you observed customer-facing errors or spikes in any internal dashboards?
- We'll follow up with a postmortem and any credit/SLAs impact if applicable.

Sorry for the disruption — we're on it.

Best,

Ben — thanks for the flag. Quick internal update:
- Ops: we've identified repeated KV-cache eviction spikes in the sable execution path under certain long-prefix sequence lengths; the kernel we shipped last week includes a new cache compaction heuristic. Under heavy concurrent short/long mixed traffic it can cause transient resource starvation and 5xx.
- Mitigation applied: rolled back the experimental kernel on the affected fleet, forced routing to sable-lite as Ben noted, and reduced batching window for sable to avoid compaction thrash.
- Impact window: 20:40–21:12 PDT; error rate returned to baseline after rollback and routing at ~21:10–21:20.

I'm opening INC-78921 and attaching a timeline. Marcus is collecting additional traces to validate. Will prepare a concise RCA for customer comms.

Rishi

Subject: Post-incident summary: Sable elevated 5xx/timeouts (root cause & remediation)

Ava / Stratos IR team — thanks again for the patience and for sending sample request IDs. Below is a concise post-incident summary and next steps. If you'd like a longer formal RCA doc we can schedule a call or share a dedicated report.

Executive summary:
- Incident window: 2028-06-04 20:40–21:12 PDT.
- Impact: intermittent 5xx (503/504) and timeouts for requests routed to the sable model; ~7% of your requests experienced errors during the peak window. Automatic routing to sable-lite reduced customer-visible failures.
- Root cause (short): a recently deployed kernel-level change to the sable runtime introduced an aggressive KV-cache compaction heuristic. Under mixed concurrent workloads with certain long-prefix sequences the heuristic triggered repeated cache compaction, causing transient memory pressure and backend request failures (5xx/timeouts).

Timeline (condensed):
- 20:40 PDT — anomalous error spike observed by our monitoring and by Stratos dashboards (reported).
- 20:45 — automated mitigation: temporary routing to sable-lite and reduced batching window.
- 20:50 — ops rollback of experimental kernel on sable fleet begins.
- 21:10 — majority of affected hosts returned to baseline; error rate back to normal by 21:12.

Actions taken / mitigations:
- Immediate: rollback of kernel change, routing/fallback to sable-lite, temporary adjustment to batching heuristics.
- Short-term (next 48–72 hrs): add canary workload checks for compaction behavior; expand synthetic tests covering long-prefix + mixed concurrency; monitor recovery metrics and backlog processing.
- Long-term: replace the compaction heuristic with a load-aware allocator and add VM-level guardrails; add quota-safe per-tenant cache caps to prevent cross-workload thrash.

Customer impact & credits:
- We will review SLA credits for the affected window; I will coordinate with finance and share a proposed credit calculation by Friday. Monica (cc) will own the billing/credit conversation.

Follow-ups we will share in a doc by end of week:
- Full incident RCA with traces and code references.
- Validation plan and release timeline for the long-term fix (ETA: targeted Q3 release with staged canary rollout).

Attachments: timeline-snapshot-logs.txt (condensed traces), screenshot-fallback-flag.png (routing view). INC-78921 is open for tracking. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/9876
